public_rationale: OpenAI announced a completed recapitalization on October 28, 2025 [e1]. On March 31, 2026, it reported a funding round with $122 billion in committed capital [e2]. These disclosures document structural and financing changes, but do not establish whether the business remained materially in its July 2024 form [e1, e2]. They also do not establish whether the specified combination of exceptional technical and financial changes occurred [e1, e2]. Neither disclosure documents permanent cessation, so neither supplies the event needed for early resolution [e1, e2].
limitations: July 29, 2029 is the contract's provisional deadline, not an explicit date in the claim. It falls after the evaluation date.
The evidence does not settle the meanings of 'current form' or the exceptional technical and financial combination.
Committed capital does not establish cash receipts or profitability.
The packet contains no independently assessable technical measurements that settle the technical condition.

our_interpretation: The forecast concerns continued operation of the business, not preservation of every legal entity or contract.
Provisionally read 'a few more years' as three to five years and use the latest endpoint, July 29, 2029. This bound is an evaluator interpretation, not an explicit deadline.
The nearby two-year statement is a separate formulation of necessary changes; it does not unambiguously replace this claim's 'few more years'.
The antecedent is continued operation in materially the same form without the exceptional combination described. Both its technical and financial components require assessment.
Because the antecedent is not established, apply the conditional-forecast rule and withhold scoring, even though the provisional horizon is also not due.
criteria.support_condition: The antecedent is established and OpenAI permanently ceases operating by the interpreted deadline, with the relevant absence of exceptional changes documented.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The antecedent is established and OpenAI continues operating beyond the interpreted deadline without the asserted combination of exceptional technical and financial changes.
